title: Sr SAP OTC and Logistics Architect, AWS FinTech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced SAP SD and GTS Functional Lead to spearhead the Sales and Distribution (SD) module for our organization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for configuring, customizing, and deploying the SD module to enhance our sales, distribution, and returns management processes.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Analyze and document business requirements related to sales, distribution, and returns management processes.
* Implement and support business processes such as B2B (Business-to-Business), Make-to-Stock, VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory), Contract Manufacturing, Vendor Consignment, Subcontracting, 3rd Party, Inter-company sales, Back Order Processing, Rebates and Settlement management.
* Design and configure the SAP SD module to meet the identified business requirements, including:
* Sales Order management in SAP S/4 HANA
* Pricing and condition techniques
* Delivery and transportation management
* Returns management and credit/debit memo processing
* Integration with other SAP modules (e.g., MM, FICO, LE, GTS)
* Customize and develop SAP SD solutions, including user exits, and enhancements, to address any gaps between standard SAP functionality and specific business needs.
* Manage and support all Sales and Distribution related Data Workflows, including all Partner EDI communications, interfaces, and APIs with external applications
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and data flow across modules.
* Implement and configure Global Trade Services (GTS) related business process and integration with SAP modules including but not limited to Sanctioned Party List (SPL), Global Trade Compliance, Trade preference management.
* Document configurations, customization, and best practices for future reference and knowledge transfer.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 10+ years implementing SAP S/4HANA SD, with focus on supply chain integration, inter and intra company scenarios, logistics integration, returns management and reverse logistics

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Information Technology) or equivalent experience.

- Deep knowledge of S/4HANA sales, distribution, BOM, and returns - order management, pricing, delivery, and credit/debit memo processing.  

* Strong grasp of SAP SD integration with MM, FI, LE, and trade compliance.
* Experience architecting partner EDI for POs, PO changes, ASN, warehouse shipping, inventory movements, and invoicing.
* Experience in FI integration with A/R, credit management, and FI reconciliation.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Lead System Engineer - Google Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead System Engineer - Google Forward Deployed Engineer** to design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients, working hands-on with Gemini Enterprise, Google ADK, and the broader Google Workspace ecosystem to deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent multi-agent systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy production-grade Multi-Agent Systems and agentic workflows using Gemini Enterprise
* Identify the need for Pro Code vs No Code design based on customer's problem statement and data sources
* Build and deploy custom agents using the ADK and Agent Platform AI Reasoning Engine, and integrate them with Gemini Enterprise
* Build native integrations across the Google Workspace Ecosystem and NotebookLM for grounded enterprise research, document automation, and conversational discovery
* Architect scalable short-term session storage, conversation state persistence, and long-term memory architectures across multi-agent interactions
* Implement end-to-end authentication and authorization perimeters for agents, GCP services, and 3rd-party SaaS integrations using IAM, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and service identities
* Enforce fine-grained ACLs, user/group permission inheritance, and data governance policies to ensure agents strictly adhere to enterprise access boundaries
* Utilize developer tooling including Agent CLI and Antigravity for local rapid prototyping, testing, emulation, distributed tracing, and RCA
* Architect HITL workflows, ensuring seamless Interrupt and Resume patterns between autonomous agents and human experts for critical decision points
* Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines to manage versioned agent deployments, automated testing, and continuous regression evaluations
* Implement advanced reasoning patterns such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Self-Reflection to enhance agent reliability
* Collaborate directly with client engineering and architecture teams to deploy, validate, and operationalize enterprise agentic AI solutions in client environments

**Requirements**

* 7-13 years of overall IT experience, including 4 to 6+ years in software development, cloud solution architecture, and AI engineering, preferably on GCP
* Proficiency in Python with production-level software engineering practices, and expertise in building multi-agent systems using Google ADK or comparable agentic frameworks
* Hands-on experience deploying and customizing Gemini Enterprise, NotebookLM, and integrating with the Google Workspace Ecosystem, including APIs, Add-ons, and Drive/Docs connectors
* Expertise in managing agent session state, short-term context caching, and durable long-term memory backends such as vector databases and relational/NoSQL session stores
* Experience with MCP Connectors to securely integrate core third-party platforms with Gemini Enterprise
* Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols across GCP and 3rd-party SaaS platforms, including IAM, OAuth 2.0, and OIDC
* Knowledge of enterprise ACLs, identity federation, permission trimming, and RBAC across heterogeneous data sources
* Proficiency in developer tooling such as Agent CLI and Antigravity for local simulation, debugging, prompt engineering, and execution graph tracing
* Proven track record of configuring and maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for agent containerization, deployment, and test automation
* Knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, trajectory analysis, and performing RCA on agent execution failures, tool errors, and prompt regressions
* Proven track record of designing, building, and deploying production AI agents or enterprise GenAI solutions using ADK, Vertex AI, or Gemini
* Hands-on experience in customer-facing technical delivery, solutions engineering, or FDE roles, with familiarity with enterprise Agile SDLC, sprint delivery, and stakeholder management

**Nice to have**

* Experience with inter-agent communication protocols such as MCP and A2A architectures
* Experience integrating agents with Enterprise Knowledge Graphs, structured ontologies, and hybrid vector search systems
* Experience with enterprise data security frameworks such as Sensitive Data Protection and VPC Service Controls

**We offer**

title: Director QA
description:
**About Us**

TechBlocks is a global digital product development firm that brings together strategy, design and technology to build digital solutions for Fortune 500 companies and global brands. Our clients include Bell Telecom, Bausch Health, Honda Motors, AES Corp, Thomson Reuters Carswell, First American and Colliers International.

Headquartered in Toronto, with offices in the U.S. and India, we help organizations improve efficiency, collaboration and user experience through consulting, product engineering and ongoing support.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of QA to lead our QA automation engineering strategy across multiple client accounts and delivery teams. You will build scalable automation capabilities, establish technical standards and integrate continuous testing into software delivery.

This role requires a technically strong leader who can guide automation architecture, review frameworks and resolve complex testing challenges while leading QA managers, automation architects and SDETs. You will partner with engineering, DevOps, product and delivery leaders to improve test coverage, shorten feedback cycles and increase release confidence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Automation Strategy and Roadmap:** Own the QA automation vision and execution roadmap across client engagements. Assess automation maturity, prioritize investments and define measurable goals for coverage, reliability, execution time and maintenance effort.
* **Framework Architecture:** Lead the design and evolution of reusable automation frameworks for web, mobile, API and backend services. Establish standards for modularity, maintainability, configuration, reporting and parallel execution.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural direction, review automation code and framework designs, and guide teams through complex implementation challenges. Promote software engineering practices within QA, including version control, code reviews and reusable libraries.
* **CI/CD and Continuous Testing:** Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to embed automated tests into build and deployment pipelines. Define appropriate test suites and quality gates for pull requests, integration builds and releases.
* **Automation Coverage:** Establish a balanced approach across unit, component, API, integration and end-to-end testing. Work with developers to test at the appropriate layer and prioritize automation based on business risk.
* **Test Reliability and Execution:** Reduce flaky tests, improve failure diagnostics and optimize execution through parallelization, cross-browser testing and cloud-based device platforms. Establish clear ownership for test failures and maintenance.
* **API and Integration Testing:** Drive automation for REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices and third-party integrations, including contract testing, authentication, data validation and negative scenarios.
* **Test Data and Environments:** Establish reliable approaches to test data creation, environment readiness, service virtualization and dependency management to support repeatable automated testing.
* **Performance and Non-Functional Testing:** Oversee performance and load-testing strategies using tools such as JMeter or k6. Partner with specialists to incorporate security and accessibility checks into delivery pipelines.
* **Team and Practice Development:** Build and mentor distributed automation teams. Define hiring standards, technical competency frameworks and development plans, and create reusable accelerators across accounts.
* **Metrics and Improvement:** Track automation effectiveness through risk coverage, escaped defects, flaky-test rates, execution duration and feedback speed. Use findings to improve frameworks and demonstrate business value.
* **Client and Delivery Leadership:** Present automation strategies, investment proposals and quality risks to clients and senior leadership. Support proposals, estimates, staffing plans and delivery commitments.
* **AI-Assisted Testing:** Evaluate practical uses of AI for test generation, maintenance and failure analysis, with clear validation and measurable outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* 14+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with substantial experience in test automation and at least 5 years leading multiple teams or programs.
* Proven experience defining and scaling automation strategies across enterprise applications and client engagements.
* Strong background in designing automation frameworks, reusable libraries and testing infrastructure.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or C#.
* Deep expertise in relevant automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WebdriverIO or Appium, with the ability to select tools based on application needs.
* Experience with API automation tools and libraries such as REST Assured, Karate, Postman/Newman or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience integrating automated testing with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Strong understanding of test architecture, test pyramid principles, contract testing, mocking and service virtualization.
* Experience with BrowserStack, Sauce Labs or equivalent platforms for cross-browser and mobile testing.
* Working knowledge of performance testing, SQL, backend validation and cloud-based application testing.
* Experience leading distributed teams within an onshore–offshore delivery model, preferably in technology consulting or digital engineering services.
* Proven ability to manage automation investments, staffing and tooling costs while improving delivery outcomes.
* Strong client communication, stakeholder management and leadership development skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience establishing an Automation or Quality Engineering Centre of Excellence.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes and containerized test execution.
* Experience testing AI-enabled applications and evaluating AI-assisted automation tools.
* Experience modernizing legacy automation suites and reducing maintenance overhead.

**About Us**

TechBlocks is a global digital product development firm that brings together strategy, design and technology to build digital solutions for Fortune 500 companies and global brands. Our clients include Bell Telecom, Bausch Health, Honda Motors, AES Corp, Thomson Reuters Carswell, First American and Colliers International.

Headquartered in Toronto, with offices in the U.S. and India, we help organizations improve efficiency, collaboration and user experience through consulting, product engineering and ongoing support.

title: Lead / Senior SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are building the next generation of enterprise AI interoperability. As an **SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer**, you will pioneer our agentic AI roadmap — designing, building, and securing cross-platform agent networks that connect SAP's Joule ecosystem with ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms over open agent communication protocols. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development, from BTP provisioning through production A2A orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy pro-code AI agents on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma) using Joule Studio, LangGraph, or SAP Cloud SDK for AI — defining agent tools, orchestration logic, and backend integrations against S/4HANA OData APIs (Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Accounts) via BTP Destination Service
* Architect and implement end-to-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0.3.0
* Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout-resilient pipelines across SAP and non-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale
* Configure end-to-end authentication across agent boundaries using OAuth2, SAP IAS App2App trust, and BTP Cloud Identity Services — enforcing least-privilege access, token governance, and audit-ready agent call chains
* Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
* Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi-hop agent calls

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on SAP BTP engineering experience, including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
* Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
* Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
* Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi-agent orchestration patterns, including delegation, fallback, and async response handling
* Solid understanding of API security and authentication: OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, SAP IAS trust configurations, and BTP service bindings
* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform internals — Now Assist AI Agents, Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Connection & Credential Aliases
* Strong grasp of distributed systems design, API performance, and fault-tolerance patterns relevant to multi-agent pipelines
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

**Nice to have**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) alongside A2A for tool and resource exposure across agent boundaries
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability
* SAP BTP or ServiceNow certifications (Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist)
* CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons

title: Principal Agentic Systems Architect
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

12

**The Role:**

  

Defines and guides the architecture of enterprise agentic systems and AI-enabled engineering capabilities. Designs reusable architectures and engineering patterns so teams can build, integrate, evaluate, secure, and operationalize agents at scale, independent of the specific framework, model, or runtime chosen. Hands-on, working across multiple initiatives to turn business and technical requirements into production-ready solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures and reusable design patterns for agent development, orchestration, tool calling, context management, multi-agent interaction, and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Set integration patterns for coding agents, agent frameworks, MCP servers, enterprise APIs, and security tools, so new agents onboard without custom one-off plumbing.

* Architect isolated, ephemeral execution environments with identity and access controls, secrets management, and full auditability.

* Establish engineering standards for the agent lifecycle: CI/CD, versioning, behavioral testing, agent evaluations, release management, and runtime operations.

* Define approaches for observability, failure handling, and production readiness across agent workloads.

* Guide engineering teams, review solution designs, evaluate technology choices, and resolve complex architectural challenges across initiatives.

* Validate architectural decisions through prototypes and proofs of concept alongside platform engineers and delivery teams.

Document patterns and standards so they are reused across projects and teams, not rebuilt each time.  

  

**Core Skills Required**

* Hands-on experience designing and building LLM-based applications, AI agents, or agentic workflows.

* Strong understanding of agent frameworks, coding agents, tool integration, MCP, and orchestration patterns.

* Cloud-native architecture experience: APIs, containers, Kubernetes, and distributed systems.

* Application security: IAM, secrets management, secure SDLC, and software supply-chain security.

* CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production engineering practices.

* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Go, sufficient to build working prototypes.

* Architectural decision-making and clear technical communication, with the ability to influence multiple teams without direct authority.

Flexibility to work across varied and evolving tech stacks, not tied to one runtime, framework, or model provider.  

  

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in software engineering, solution architecture, or distributed systems, including 2+ years building LLM or agent-based systems.

* Experience in secure/regulated enterprise environments preferred.

* Nice to have: experience with enterprise coding-agent platforms (e.g., Devin, GitHub Copilot agents, Claude Code) or similar AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Drone Data Architect
description:
**Role Summary**

The Drone Data Architect owns the data foundation of the platform. You will design how drone video and imagery (both live streams and bulk uploads) are ingested, validated, processed, indexed, stored and served to tenants; how flight telemetry is bound to every frame and image; and how existing MVP customer data is migrated safely into the multi-tenant model. Your designs set the standard for every team that touches media, metadata, geospatial data or inference results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Ingestion Architecture**

* **Bulk upload:** Design resumable, chunked uploads (S3 multipart with presigned URLs, or tus protocol) with per-part checksums (SHA-256/CRC32C), retry and resume for low-bandwidth field connections, client-side manifest, and server-side completeness validation.

* **Live ingest:** Architect live feeds over RTSP, RTMP/SRT and WebRTC (WHIP) into a media gateway (MediaMTX, Kinesis Video Streams or equivalent), with reconnect handling, jitter and packet-loss tolerance, and fan-out to HLS/LL-HLS for viewing and to inference workers.

* **Processing:** Define FFmpeg/GStreamer pipelines: probe and validation (ffprobe), codec normalisation (H.264/H.265/AV1), proxy renditions and adaptive bitrate ladders, keyframe and interval frame extraction, thumbnails, sprite sheets, tiling of large orthomosaics and high-resolution stills.

* **Real-time vs. batch:** Specify which flows are real-time (latency targets, frame-sampling rates) and which are batch; define back-pressure, queue topology (Kafka topics or SQS queues), partitioning keys by tenant and flight, ordering guarantees and exactly-once effect via idempotent processing.

* **Throughput sizing:** Model ingest bandwidth, storage growth per tenant, concurrent streams, GPU hand-off rate and egress cost; publish sizing sheets and scaling thresholds.

**Telemetry and Metadata Model**

* **Image metadata:** Extract and normalise EXIF/XMP (including DJI drone-dji namespace: GPS, relative/absolute altitude, gimbal yaw/pitch/roll, flight yaw, camera intrinsics, RTK flags) with exiftool; handle vendor differences and missing fields.

* **Video telemetry:** Parse DJI SRT/subtitle telemetry, MAVLink tlog and dataflash logs, PX4 ULog and vendor flight-log exports into a canonical telemetry schema (time-series of position, attitude, speed, battery, sensor state).

* **Time synchronisation:** Define frame-to-telemetry alignment (clock offsets, interpolation, drift correction, timezone and GPS-time handling) so every frame carries a position and pose with a quality flag.

* **Canonical model:** Design the entity model: Organisation/Tenant, Site, Mission, Flight, Media Asset, Frame, Telemetry Sample, Detection, Track, Annotation, Report; define identifiers (ULID/UUIDv7), versioning and provenance (source file hash, software version, processing lineage).

**Geospatial Data Design**

* **Spatial store:** Decide and document the split between MongoDB (2dsphere indexes, GeoJSON for operational queries) and PostGIS (analytics, joins, raster/vector processing); define SRIDs (EPSG:4326 storage, projected CRS for measurement), GiST indexes, partitioning and query patterns.

* **Formats:** Support GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, GeoPackage, Shapefile import/export, and cloud-optimised outputs (COG, PMTiles, vector tiles via pg\_tileserv or equivalent).

* **Catalogue:** Design a STAC-style catalogue so assets can be discovered by tenant, site, time, footprint and sensor; define footprint computation from pose, camera model and terrain (DEM) where available.

* **Detection geo-referencing:** Specify how pixel detections are projected to world coordinates (camera intrinsics, gimbal pose, altitude/DEM, ground sampling distance) and how accuracy is recorded.

**Storage, Tiering and Retention**

* **Layout:** Design object key layout and prefixes by tenant/site/flight/asset, immutable originals plus derived artefacts, and versioning rules; avoid hot-prefix throttling.

* **Tiering:** Define hot, warm and archive tiers (e.g. S3 Standard, Intelligent-Tiering, Glacier Instant Retrieval, Deep Archive; Azure Hot/Cool/Archive) with lifecycle rules, restore workflows and cost models by plan.

* **Isolation:** Implement tenant isolation using per-tenant prefixes, IAM/bucket policies, per-tenant KMS data keys (envelope encryption), signed URL scope and access logging.

* **Retention and deletion:** Define retention policies per plan, legal hold, tenant offboarding and verified deletion (including derived data and backups), in line with GDPR.

**Results Data and API Delivery**

* **Inference outputs:** Design schemas for detections, tracks and segmentation masks (COCO/GeoJSON/Parquet), model-version tagging, confidence thresholds and reprocessing without data loss.

* **Query and delivery:** Define APIs for time/space/class queries, tiled map delivery, signed media delivery (CDN with token auth), pagination and bulk export; set performance budgets (e.g. p95 query latency).

* **Analytics:** Define a columnar analytics layer (Parquet on object storage queried by Athena/Synapse or similar) for reporting and model evaluation datasets.

**MVP Migration**

* **Assessment:** Inventory MVP data stores, files and metadata quality; map MVP schemas to the canonical model with a documented transformation spec.

* **Execution:** Design idempotent, resumable migration jobs with manifests, checksum verification, dual-read or shadow validation, per-tenant cutover, rollback plan and reconciliation reports.

* **Remediation:** Backfill missing telemetry/EXIF where possible and flag data-quality exceptions for customer review.

**Quality, Observability and Governance**

* **Data quality:** Define validation rules, quarantine paths for bad media, and data-quality scorecards.

* **Observability:** Define pipeline metrics (ingest lag, bytes/s, failed-asset rate, time-to-first-result, storage per tenant) and alerts with the DevOps/SRE engineer.

* **Governance:** Maintain data dictionary, lineage, ADRs and schema-evolution policy; review all schema and storage changes.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **8+ years in data or software architecture, including 3+ years with drone, aerial or video data.**

* Deep experience designing large video/image pipelines on cloud object storage (S3, Azure Blob or GCS), including multipart upload, lifecycle and tiering.

* Hands-on FFmpeg and/or GStreamer; streaming protocols RTSP, RTMP/SRT, WebRTC, HLS/DASH.

* Drone metadata expertise: EXIF/XMP, DJI telemetry (SRT), MAVLink or PX4 logs; time-sync of telemetry with video.

* Geospatial data engineering: PostGIS, GeoJSON, KML, GDAL/OGR, coordinate reference systems, spatial indexing.

* MongoDB data modelling and indexing, including geospatial (2dsphere) and time-series patterns.

* Event-driven pipelines (Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS), idempotency and back-pressure design.

* Multi-tenant data isolation patterns, envelope encryption and KMS.

* Data migration at scale with validation and rollback.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* STAC, COG, PMTiles, TiTiler or similar cloud-native geospatial tooling.

* Photogrammetry outputs (orthomosaic, point cloud, DEM) and tools such as ODM or Pix4D.

* Parquet/Iceberg, Athena or Spark for analytics.

* Kinesis Video Streams, AWS IVS or Azure Media Services.

* Experience sizing GPU inference hand-off and frame-sampling strategies.

* Cost optimisation at petabyte scale; FinOps tagging by tenant.

**Key Deliverables**

* Ingestion architecture document and sequence diagrams (live and bulk).

* Canonical data model, telemetry schema and data dictionary.

* Geospatial design and storage decision record (MongoDB vs. PostGIS).

* Storage layout, tiering, retention and tenant-isolation specification.

* Sizing and cost model.

* MVP migration plan, tooling spec and reconciliation report templates.

* Pipeline observability dashboard specification.

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Geoinformatics, Engineering or equivalent experience.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

In this role, working with our managed services partner you will design, develop, and maintain secure, enterprise-scale web applications from the user interface down to the backend infrastructure. A critical component of this role involves containerizing microservices and managing deployments seamlessly across multi-cloud/hybrid Kubernetes platforms, specifically Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and VMware vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS).

This role also involves troubleshooting, documenting issues, and collaborating with development & Infrastructure teams to enhance application performance ensuring that applications function effectively and meet business needs.

**Typical Duties and Responsibilities**

* Knowledge of Microservices, Event-driven architecture (Kafka/PubSub), REST APIs
* Knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), React.js or Angular, HTML5, CSS3 technologies
* Experienced in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GKE, VKS, Docker, Helm
* Knowledge of application support tools, techniques and methodologies.
* Experienced in Git, Jenkins / GitHub Actions, Maven or Gradle
* Knowledge of Integrating Anthropic API and advanced AI capabilities to expand platform functionality will be advantage

* Communication Skills - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to interact effectively with end-users and other teams.
* Problem-Solving Skills - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Ability to conduct root cause analysis and implement solutions- Technical knowledge in Windows & Linux environments

Collaborate with other IT teams, such as Network, Linux and Application Development, to address issues that span multiple areas.

title: Lead Technical Onboarding Engineer
description:
**About Neo4j:**

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world's largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

**Our Vision:**

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we're disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

### **About the Job**

You will play a critical, hands-on role in guiding enterprise customers through the foundational stages of their deployment journey. As a **player-coach and technical anchor for a focused four-person onboarding team**, you will split your time between directly delivering complex customer onboardings and serving as the day-to-day technical escalation point and mentor for three fellow engineers.

Sitting at the intersection of technical architecture and customer delivery, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, steering customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.

For fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self-managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deploy secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

### **Responsibilities**

**Hands-on Technical Onboarding (~70–80%)**

* Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to define success criteria, milestones, architecture patterns, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Guide the provisioning of Neo4j AuraDB environments and self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, and peering.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO (OIDC/SAML) and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise customer development teams on Neo4j driver optimisation, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools (logs and metrics) and deliver best-practice guidance on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and runbooks—to ensure smooth operational handoffs.

**Technical Mentorship & Team Escalation (~20–30%)**

* Serve as the senior technical point of escalation for the onboarding team, unblocking colleagues on complex customer architectures and troubleshooting edge-case issues.
* Pair with and mentor team members through design reviews, architecture discussions, and customer engagements to continuously elevate collective technical execution.
* Help balance day-to-day account coverage across the team to maintain consistent onboarding velocity and delivery quality.
* Synthesise field insights, lessons learned, and reusable blueprints to iterate and optimise our core onboarding methodologies, tooling, and onboarding automation.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Onboarding Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting), with informal or formal experience acting as a technical lead, mentor, or escalation point.
* Proven track record of operating in a hands-on "player-coach" capacity—comfortable rolling up your sleeves on implementation while guiding peers.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying production workloads in at least one major cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep technical proficiency in core enterprise networking (VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints).
* Demonstrated experience configuring Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, alongside configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible).
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container services).
* Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in query performance tuning (e.g., Cypher optimisation).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data integration/ETL/CDC tools.
* Exposure to cloud compliance standards (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and multi-region/data residency deployment patterns.

**Why Join Neo4j?**

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

* Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
* Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
* 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
* Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
* Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
* A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don't meet all the qualifications. **If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we'd encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application.** At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

**Neo4j Values:**

Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:

Neo4j is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. Please read the privacy notice regarding Neo4j's recruitment process to understand how we will handle the personal data that you provide.

title: AWS Engineer
description:
AWS Engineer – UKI SAPDecomEnabler  
Role Purpose  
We are looking for an experienced AWS Engineer to join the UKI SAPDecomEnabler squad, supporting Centrica's technology transformation and SAP decommissioning programme.  
The engineer will be responsible for designing, building, automating and supporting secure and scalable AWS based solutions that enable the migration, integration, archival and decommissioning of legacy SAP related workloads and associated services.  
The role requires strong hands on AWS engineering capability combined with Infrastructure as Code, DevOps automation, integration and operational support experience. The successful candidate will work within a cross functional Agile squad alongside architects, application engineers, SAP teams, security, infrastructure, product and business stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities  
AWS Engineering & Cloud Solutions  
  
. Design, build and maintain secure, resilient and scalable solutions on AWS.  
. Develop AWS infrastructure and services supporting application migration and SAP decommissioning activities.  
. Build cloud native and serverless solutions using appropriate AWS managed services.  
. Configure and manage services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, EC2, ECS, IAM, CloudWatch, EventBridge, SNS/SQS and related AWS services.  
. Design solutions considering availability, scalability, performance, security and cost optimisation.  
. Support the migration and transition of workloads and integrations away from legacy platforms into strategic cloud services.  
  
SAP Decommissioning Enablement  
  
. Work with SAP, application and architecture teams to understand legacy SAP dependencies, interfaces and downstream systems.  
. Enable technical solutions required to progressively decouple applications and services from legacy SAP platforms.  
. Support migration, extraction, archival and integration requirements associated with SAP system decommissioning.  
. Identify and resolve application, infrastructure and integration dependencies that could impact decommissioning.  
. Ensure replacement AWS services meet agreed functional and non functional requirements before legacy components are retired.  
. Support technical cutover, validation, hypercare and controlled retirement of legacy services.  
  
Infrastructure as Code & Automation  
  
. Build and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.  
. Automate environment provisioning, configuration and deployment wherever possible.  
. Develop reusable infrastructure modules and patterns aligned with Centrica engineering standards.  
. Reduce manual operational activities through scripting and automation using Python, Bash and/or Node.js/TypeScript.  
  
DevOps & CI/CD  
  
. Build, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.  
. Work with Git/GitHub and modern continuous integration and deployment practices.  
. Implement automated build, testing, security scanning and deployment controls.  
. Promote repeatable, auditable and low risk deployment processes across environments.  
. Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering and DevOps practices within the squad.  
  
Integration & Data  
  
. Design and support integrations between AWS services, enterprise applications and legacy/SAP platforms.  
. Develop and consume REST APIs and event driven interfaces.  
. Work with asynchronous messaging and event driven architecture patterns where appropriate.  
. Support secure movement, transformation and storage of data required during migration and decommissioning.  
. Collaborate with data and SAP teams to ensure data retention, archival and access requirements are addressed.  
  
Security, Monitoring & Operational Resilience  
  
. Implement AWS security best practices covering IAM, encryption, secrets management, network security and least privilege access.  
. Ensure solutions comply with Centrica security, data protection and technology standards.  
. Implement logging, monitoring, dashboards and alerting using AWS CloudWatch and enterprise monitoring tools.  
. Proactively identify reliability and performance issues.  
. Participate in incident investigation, root cause analysis and problem resolution.  
. Ensure appropriate operational documentation, runbooks and support procedures are maintained.  
  
Agile & Stakeholder Collaboration  
  
. Work as part of the UKI SAPDecomEnabler cross functional Agile squad.  
. Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, SAP SMEs, Security, QA, DevOps and Operations teams.  
. Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical design discussions, stand ups and retrospectives.  
. Translate business and architectural requirements into robust technical solutions.  
. Raise technical risks, dependencies and blockers early and drive them through to resolution.  
. Participate in peer reviews and contribute to engineering standards and knowledge sharing.  
  
Mandatory Technical Skills  
  
. 5+ years of experience in software/cloud/infrastructure engineering.  
. Strong hands on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).  
. Practical experience with AWS services such as: Lambda API Gateway S3 EC2 / ECS IAM CloudWatch EventBridge SNS / SQS  
. Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform and/or CloudFormation.  
. Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps engineering practices.  
. Experience with Git/GitHub and automated deployment pipelines.  
. Programming/scripting experience using Python, Node.js/TypeScript and/or Bash.  
. Experience developing and integrating REST APIs.  
. Understanding of serverless and event driven architectures.  
. Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting and production support.  
. Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM and secure engineering principles.  
. Experience supporting production grade enterprise systems.  
  
Preferred Skills  
  
. Previous experience supporting SAP transformation, SAP migration or SAP decommissioning programmes.  
. Understanding of SAP interfaces, integration patterns and legacy application dependencies.  
. Experience migrating enterprise applications from legacy/on premises environments to AWS.  
. Experience with data migration, archival and retention solutions.  
. Knowledge of containers, Docker and Kubernetes/ECS.  
. Experience working within large enterprise technology transformation programmes.  
. Familiarity with SRE practices and highly available production services.  
. AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional or AWS Certified Developer/DevOps Engineer would be advantageous.  
  
Behavioural Competencies  
  
. Strong analytical and problem solving capability.  
. Takes end to end ownership of assigned technical deliverables.  
. Comfortable working independently while contributing effectively within a squad.  
. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.  
. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non technical stakeholders.  
. Proactive in identifying risks, dependencies and opportunities for automation.  
. Strong focus on engineering quality, security and operational resilience.  
. Continuous improvement and learning mindset.  
  
Expected Outcomes  
The AWS Engineer will help the UKI SAPDecom Enabler squad:  
  
. Accelerate safe decommissioning of legacy SAP related technology.  
. Reduce dependencies on legacy platforms through AWS based replacement capabilities.  
. Deliver secure and reusable cloud services and integration patterns.  
. Automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment.  
. Improve resilience, observability and maintainability of transitioned services.  
. Ensure migrated services are production ready before legacy components are retired.  
. Support Centrica's broader technology modernization and cloud transformation objectives.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

title: Intune Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled Microsoft Intune Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Group Policy (GPO).

  

In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure.

  

At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead Microsoft Intune administration, configuration, and optimization across enterprise environments, ensuring efficient endpoint management and service delivery.
* Manage the complete endpoint lifecycle, including device enrollment, application deployment, compliance policies, OS updates, and Windows endpoint administration.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and drive modernization initiatives, including migration from traditional Group Policy (GPO) management to cloud-native solutions.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and cloud teams to enhance endpoint security, governance compliance, audit readiness, and user experience.
Provide technical leadership, troubleshooting expertise, automation-driven improvements, and mentorship while championing modern workplace transformation.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Qualification**

  

* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune, providing platform administration, support, troubleshooting, and endpoint management for enterprise environments.
* Proven experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Group Policy (GPO) administration and migration, and managing large-scale Windows 10/11 endpoint ecosystems.
* Skilled in device compliance, configuration management, security baselines, Zero Trust principles, and modern workplace/endpoint management best practices.
* Extensive experience with Windows Autopilot, endpoint modernization initiatives, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration, and hybrid identity/cloud integration scenarios.
Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation and operational efficiency, with working knowledge of CMDB, ITSM, and enterprise service management tools.  

**Preferred Qualification**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals
* Microsoft Intune Administration Certifications
* Microsoft Entra ID Certifications
Modern Workplace or Endpoint Management Certifications  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. title: Sr DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

10

**Role:**

Senior DevSecOps Engineer – Enterprise Developer Platform and Toolchain

  

**The Team**

The Enterprise Developer Platform & Toolchain team owns the platforms, tools and capabilities that support software engineers across S&P Global. Our core functions span DevOps, DevSecOps, FinOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Developer Experience (DevEx). We partner with divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Information Security (InfoSec) to establish consistent controls and governance across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). As a globally distributed team, we build services, policies and automated controls that secure the developer toolchain while keeping platforms simple, consistent and engineer friendly.

  

**The Impact**

You will embed security governance into the software delivery lifecycle by translating requirements into clear policies and automated controls. Your work will protect source control, CI/CD pipelines, build infrastructure and the software supply chain without creating unnecessary friction for engineers. You will strengthen credentials, secrets and non-human identity governance; drive security findings through to remediation; and contribute to AI-assisted development governance and developer endpoint security. Working with platform teams, divisional DevOps/TechOps teams and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs), you will support audit and compliance and make secure practices the default across S&P Global.

  

**What’s in It for You**

Help shape how thousands of engineers build and ship software securely. You will work hands-on with enterprise security tooling and emerging areas such as AI tool governance and policy as code. You will own controls end to end, from policy design to automated enforcement, and collaborate with InfoSec, audit and engineering leaders. We support your growth through innovation projects, training, certification support and knowledge sharing.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define and implement baseline security policies and automated guardrails across source control and CI/CD environments.
* Integrate, manage and tune code quality and application security tools, including SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), Checkmarx and Wiz, within developer workflows.
* Triage security findings, prioritise vulnerabilities by risk and track remediation against service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Establish governance for credentials, secrets and non-human identities across the developer toolchain.
* Harden build infrastructure and software supply chain controls, including artifact management with JFrog Artifactory/Xray.
* Provision, secure and optimise AWS services supporting the developer platform, including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, IAM and CloudFormation/CDK.
* Contribute to governance for AI-assisted development tools and developer endpoint security.
* Monitor sensitive configuration changes, implement alerting and support audit and compliance activities.
* Partner with platform and engineering teams to automate security controls and drive adoption.
  

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5–8 years of experience in DevSecOps, application security or security governance.
* Strong experience designing and automating enterprise-scale CI/CD pipelines, with an understanding of source control security and common pipeline threats.
* Hands-on knowledge of GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, runners, rulesets and policies.
* Strong understanding of repository lifecycle management and Git practices, including Conventional Commits, semantic versioning, trunk-based development/GitFlow and pull request workflows.
* Hands-on experience with static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning or cloud security tools.
* Ability to write clear security policies and standards and translate them into technical enforcement.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, including single sign-on (SSO), role-based access control (RBAC) and least privilege.
* Proficiency with infrastructure as code, including Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK, and familiarity with configuration management tools.
* Experience with AWS compute, networking, storage, IAM and container orchestration (ECS/EKS), including AWS security practices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python or Bash; familiarity with TypeScript/Node.js.
* Understanding of configuration management databases (CMDBs) and ITIL-aligned change management, including approvals and audit trails.
* Awareness of AI tool governance and developer endpoint security, including mobile device management (MDM).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to influence adoption across engineering teams.
  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot and Cursor IDE, and developer agents/MCP integrations.
* Contributions to open-source Backstage plugins or internal developer platform (IDP) ecosystems.
* Familiarity with compliance as code and policy engines such as OPA or Sentinel.
* AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD).
* Security certifications, such as CSSLP, Security+ or AWS Security.
  

**Technical Environment**

**Source Control & CI/CD Security:** GitHub Enterprise security features, GitHub Actions hardening, OIDC and GitHub Apps

**Application Security:** SAST/SCA tooling, including Checkmarx, SonarQube and GHAS

**Cloud & Container Security:** Wiz or similar cloud security posture management (CSPM) and vulnerability tools

**Software Supply Chain:** Artifactory/Xray or similar tooling, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and artifact signing

**Secrets & Identity:** Vault or other secrets managers, Okta or similar tooling, and non-human identity governance

**Runners & Endpoints:** Runner hardening tools and MDM

**AI Governance:** Copilot controls, MCP and agent guardrails

**Monitoring:** Splunk or similar security information and event management (SIEM) tooling

**Automation & Cloud Security:** Python, Bash, Terraform and AWS security (IAM, KMS)

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technology-related field.

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**  
**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
  
  
Our benefits include:

* Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
* Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
* Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* **Design and recommend end-to-end infrastructure solutions** that balance technical feasibility, customer requirements, project timelines, risks, and operational priorities.
* **Analyze and troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues** across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems to identify root causes and restore services effectively.
* **Plan and integrate hybrid cloud and on-premises environments** , ensuring seamless connectivity, interoperability, reliability, and operational continuity across platforms.
* **Automate infrastructure workflows and technical processes** to improve efficiency, reliability, consistency, and repeatability while reducing manual errors.
* **Proactively assess and mitigate technical and operational risks** , implementing preventive measures to minimize service disruptions and improve infrastructure resilience.
* **Lead and coordinate infrastructure project delivery** by collaborating with Architects, Project Managers, Technicians, and other cross-functional teams from initiation through completion.
* **Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders** , maintain architecture and operational documentation, and support effective knowledge transfer and hand-offs.
* **Continuously develop technical expertise** across cloud, enterprise infrastructure, and emerging technologies through certifications, practical project experience, and progression toward senior technical or Architect-level roles.

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Skills and Experience**

* **Azure Administration:** 5+ years in provision and manage **Azure Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, VNets, NSGs, Load Balancers, resource groups, disks, and networking** , including VM resizing, migration, troubleshooting, and secure decommissioning.
* **Windows & Linux Administration:** Manage and troubleshoot **Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 and RHEL 7/8/9** , including installation, configuration, upgrades, decommissioning, user/group management, system services, security, and performance issues.
* **VMware Administration:** Administer **VMware vSphere 7/8, ESXi, vCenter, clusters, datastores/vSAN, resource pools, VMware Tools, HA, DRS, and vMotion** , including VM provisioning, migration, cloning, and lifecycle management.
* **Storage & File Services:** Manage **Windows file shares, NTFS/share permissions, ARS-based access workflows, LVM, Multipath, NFS, Samba, file systems, and storage allocations** , including troubleshooting access and capacity issues.
* **Patching & Upgrades:** Perform Windows, Linux, Azure VM, and VMware patching using tools such as **Azure Update Manager and Red Hat Satellite** , including pre-checks, deployment, reboot coordination, post-validation, repository synchronization, and troubleshooting failed updates.
* **Backup & Disaster Recovery:** Configure and support **Azure Backup, Recovery Services Vault, Azure Site Recovery (ASR), VMware backup/DR, and Linux recovery procedures** , including replication, test/planned failovers, failback, restores, retention, and backup-health monitoring.
* **Monitoring & Troubleshooting:** Diagnose **CPU, memory, disk, network, boot, RDP/SSH, Event Viewer, systemd, datastore, replication, backup, and virtualization issues** , while using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and alerts for infrastructure monitoring.
* **Security, Automation & Operations:** Support **Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, Microsoft Entra ID, IAM, SELinux, Linux hardening, NSGs, SSH, Ansible, PowerShell and Shell scripting** , while handling incidents, service requests/RITMs, changes, vulnerability remediation, capacity, and resource optimization.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior ServiceNow Platform Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
ServiceNow Engineer
  
  
About Lilly
  
  
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
  
About the IT Organization
  
  
Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting edge technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Technology at Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of the enterprise.
  
Digital Core is at the forefront of digitalization to enable and advance the entire company, with increased productivity and best-in-class Customer experiences. This team provides a robust and sustainable infrastructure of hardware, software and services that are critical to enable our global workforce. As leaders in technology, this team defines and leads the overall company technology strategy.
  
  
About the Team
  
  
Global Service Management (GSM) team works to enable Lilly to enhance global productivity and protect our Brand. The team manages the industry leading ServiceNow enterprise platform. We enable our 69k global workforce to accelerate how they work, manage critical action plans, and enhance their working methods/environment, and manage key vendor contracts / spending.
  
In addition to maintaining operational excellence for our existing services, we must boldly innovate and enhance capabilities such as generative AI, automation & workflows across the enterprise. This will enable us to enhance our return on investment, improve user efficiency and experience, and help support the broader Company purpose of making life better for people around the world.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  
As a ServiceNow Engineer on the ServiceNow platform, you'll serve as a senior technical SME and strategic leader within our Global Service Management organization. You'll drive platform innovation, lead technical delivery, and ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems. You'll collaborate with architects, developers, vendors, and business stakeholders to shape and evolve our ServiceNow ecosystem.
  
In this role, you will also be expected to leverage and contribute to ServiceNow's rapidly evolving Agentic AI capabilities. This includes working with the ServiceNow Agentic AI Suite — encompassing Now Assist (Otto), ServiceNow's generative AI assistant that powers intelligent search, summarization, and conversational experiences across the platform — as well as Now Assist for Creator, which accelerates development by enabling AI-assisted flow design, code generation, and natural-language-to-configuration capabilities. You will be expected to evaluate, adopt, and operationalize these AI-native features to drive automation, improve developer productivity, and enhance the end-user experience across the enterprise.
  
This is a Dev-Ops role, which means the position operates on a rotational shift basis. You will be required to work either morning shifts or evening shifts to ensure round-the-clock platform support, incident response, and operational continuity across global time zones.
  
  
How You Will Succeed
  
  

* Platform Leadership: Own the technical roadmap for ServiceNow capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business goals.
* Solution Delivery: Lead end-to-end technical delivery for new features, including configuration, workflow design, UI customization, reporting, and integrations.
* Integration Strategy: Architect and implement integrations with LDAP/Active Directory, SSO (SAML, SiteMinder), REST/SOAP APIs, cloud platforms (AWS, VMware), and enterprise systems.
* Governance & Standards: Conduct impact analysis and code reviews to ensure conformance with architecture, data, and integration standards.
* Collaboration: Partner with Platform Architects, Technical Leads, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.
* Support & Optimization: Provide expert-level troubleshooting and performance tuning across the platform.
* Documentation & Enablement: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and mentor junior engineers.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay current with ServiceNow releases and industry trends to drive platform evolution.

What You Will Bring
  
  

* Deep technical expertise in the ServiceNow platform, including administration, scripting, and application development.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, CMDB, and configuration management principles.
* Proven experience leading technical delivery across the full software lifecycle.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive mindset and commitment to excellence.
* A passion for mentoring, learning, and driving cross-functional success.

Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 8 years of experience in ServiceNow development.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and ServiceNow scripting.Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and integration tools.Fluent in English for verbal and written communications, is essential.

Additional Skills/Preferences
  
  

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is a plus.
* Applied knowledge of ITIL v3 or ITIL v4.
* Experience with AWS, VMware, JDBC/ODBC, and enterprise data management.
* Demonstrated ability to drive platform strategy and cross-functional alignment.
* A great sense of humor and passion for engaging people.

Travel
  
  
0-10%
  
Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required.
