description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Senior Jira Align Administrator, Enterprise Insights & Power Automate**

**Experience:** 10+ Years

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Jira Align Administrator to lead Jira Align platform strategy, governance, enterprise integrations, reporting enablement, automation initiatives, and Center of Excellence (CoE) development. This role will serve as the subject matter expert for Jira Align architecture, enterprise-scale Agile portfolio management, Enterprise Insights reporting, Power Platform automation, and Jira-Jira Align ecosystem governance.

The Senior Administrator will provide strategic guidance to business and technology stakeholders, define platform standards, oversee complex implementations, mentor junior administrators, and drive continuous platform optimization across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Jira Align Strategic Administration & Governance**

* Define and enforce Jira Align governance standards, operating models, and configuration best practices.
* Design and oversee Jira-to-Jira Align integration strategies across enterprise portfolios.
* Lead onboarding of large-scale portfolios, programs, value streams, and teams into Jira Align.
* Architect and maintain Jira Align hierarchy structures, portfolios, programs, teams, roles, permissions, and access models.
* Lead implementation of advanced Jira Align capabilities including:
  + Solution Layers
  + Capability Layers
  + Custom Rooms
  + Strategic Portfolio Management features
* Perform impact assessments for configuration changes and major platform enhancements.
* Govern release management, change control, and platform roadmap planning.

**Enterprise Platform & Automation Leadership**

* Lead the design and implementation of enterprise automation solutions using Power Automate.
* Establish automation governance, reusable templates, monitoring standards, and support processes.
* Design integrations between Jira Align, Jira, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and enterprise systems.
* Evaluate new automation opportunities and drive platform modernization initiatives.

**Enterprise Insights & Analytics Leadership**

* Define enterprise reporting strategy for Jira Align.
* Establish Enterprise Insights reporting standards and SQL query governance.
* Design reusable Enterprise Insights reporting frameworks.
* Lead development and review of Power BI dashboards.
* Guide business stakeholders on reporting architecture, data interpretation, and analytics best practices.
* Optimize Enterprise Insights SQL performance and reporting reliability.

**Production Support & Platform Optimization**

* Serve as the highest escalation point for platform and synchronization issues.
* Lead root cause analysis for critical incidents and recurring platform issues.
* Drive data quality improvement initiatives and governance controls.
* Assess license utilization, adoption trends, and platform maturity.
* Recommend optimization and cost-control opportunities.

**Leadership & Enablement**

* Mentor Jira Align Administrators and junior platform resources.
* Lead administrator enablement programs and CoE development initiatives.
* Conduct architecture reviews and governance forums.
* Establish operational documentation standards and knowledge repositories.
* Coordinate with Atlassian Support and external vendors for complex issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of overall IT experience.
* 5+ years administering Jira Align in enterprise environments.
* Deep expertise in:
  + Jira Align configuration and administration
  + Enterprise Agile planning frameworks
  + Jira administration
  + Jira-Jira Align connectors
  + Portfolio and Program management structures
* Strong expertise in Enterprise Insights architecture and SQL-based reporting.
* Extensive experience with Power BI and executive reporting solutions.
* Advanced experience with Microsoft Power Automate and enterprise workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, authentication, and security models.
* Experience leading governance initiatives, CoEs, and platform transformation programs.
* Excellent stakeholder management and consulting skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Atlassian Certified Jira Align Administrator.
* Atlassian Certified Jira Administrator.
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications.
* Microsoft Power BI certifications.
* Experience in regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience leading large-scale Jira Align implementations and migrations.

**Compensation**

title: Enterprise Integration Specialist - Senior Manager
description:
**Position Summary:**

  

The Officer, Enterprise Integration Specialist will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integrations across cybersecurity, engineering, operations, identity, and data platforms. The role will enable the onboarding of new data sources, automate workflow orchestration, and establish seamless connectivity between enterprise systems to improve operational efficiency, risk visibility, and remediation effectiveness.

This position will serve as a key technical partner across Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Application Development, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure data flows, system integrations, and business processes are scalable, reliable, and well-governed.

  
  
  

### **Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

***Integration & Data Onboarding-***

  

* Design and implement integrations to onboard new enterprise data sources, including vulnerability scanners, asset inventories, cloud security platforms, and operational tooling.
* Develop API-based, event-driven, and batch integrations to aggregate and normalize data from disparate systems.
* Define and maintain integration standards, schemas, and data mapping frameworks.
  

  

***Workflow Automation & Orchestration-***

  

* Automate end-to-end workflows across security, engineering, operations, and governance processes.
* Enable automated ticket creation, assignment, escalation, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Design workflow integrations that improve traceability and reduce manual effort across teams.
* Enterprise Platform Integration
  

  

**Build and maintain integrations with platforms such as:**

  

* Jira
* GitHub / Git-based repositories
* ServiceNow
* IAM
* GCS Data Lakehouse and enterprise data platforms
* Vulnerability management and security scanning solutions
* CI/CD and DevSecOps toolchains
* Asset management and CMDB platforms
  

  

**Data Engineering & Analytics-**

  

* Develop and support data ingestion pipelines, transformations, and enrichment processes.
* Create integration patterns that support enterprise reporting, analytics, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and auditability across integrated systems.
  

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration-**

  

* Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data, Risk, and Business teams to understand integration requirements and priorities.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and Engineering Leads to develop integration roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Support onboarding of new platforms, capabilities, and enterprise services.
  

  

**Security & Compliance-**

  

* Ensure integrations comply with enterprise security, privacy, and data governance standards.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data protection controls.
* Support audit, regulatory, and risk-management initiatives as required.
  

  

### **Required Skills & Experience:**

  

* Strong experience with REST APIs, Graph APIs, webhooks, messaging frameworks, and system integrations.
* Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar integration technologies.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, and identity management systems.
* Knowledge of ETL processes, data pipelines, and enterprise data architectures.
* Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, and workflow automation concepts.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
  

  

### **Preferred Skills:**

  
  

* Experience integrating cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and risk-management platforms.
* Familiarity with SailPoint, cloud platforms, and enterprise data lake architectures.
* Knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience in Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.
  

  

### **Success Measures:**

  
  

* Successful onboarding of new enterprise data sources and platforms.

title: Principal Data Architect - Multi-Cloud (GCP & Azure)
description:
We are seeking a Principal Data Architect to define and drive enterprise data architecture, modernization, and governance strategies across complex multi-cloud (Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure) and hybrid environments. This role will design scalable, secure, and high-performing data platforms while partnering with business and engineering leaders to translate strategic objectives into impactful data solutions.

A key focus of this role will be spearheading scalable, agent-driven data migration pipelines to transition legacy on-premises data assets to the cloud, setting the technical direction for engineering teams, and actively managing the customer's technical backlog and delivery roadmap.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Cloud Lakehouse Architecture: Lead the end-to-end architecture, design, and implementation of scalable Data Lakehouse solutions across Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, GCS, BigLake, Dataplex) and Microsoft Azure (Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks).
* On-Prem to Cloud Migration & Agentic Pipelines: Architect and deploy automated, scalable, agent-driven data pipelines (leveraging GenAI agents and metadata-driven frameworks) to orchestrate, validate, and accelerate complex migrations from on-premises legacy warehouses/databases (Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server) to GCP and Azure.
* Client Engagement & Advisory: Collaborate directly with customers to understand business goals, data challenges, and technical requirements; translate them into robust architectural blueprints, technical roadmaps, and actionable delivery plans.
* Customer Technical Backlog Management: Own and actively manage the customer technical backlog—translating business epics into technical user stories, prioritizing technical debt, defining sprint milestones, and aligning backlog items with business ROI.
* Modern Ingestion & Streaming: Design and implement data pipelines supporting both real-time and batch ingestion using modern orchestration (Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory, Airflow) and streaming/messaging frameworks (Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, Azure Event Hubs).
* Governance & Lineage: Establish and enforce best practices for unified data cataloging, metadata management, automated lineage, and data quality across multi-cloud and on-prem systems using Dataplex, Microsoft Purview, or open-source governance tools.
* Security & Compliance: Define and implement robust data security, identity management (IAM / Azure Entra ID), encryption, row/column-level access control, and regulatory compliance standards across clouds.
* Team Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Steer the overarching technical direction of engineering teams; establish architectural standards, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, conduct architecture review, and ensure engineering excellence.
* Hands-on Delivery & Prototyping: Balance strategic architecture discussions with hands-on solutioning, architectural spikes, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), and performance tuning of complex multi-cloud distributed workloads.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with enterprise architects, delivery leads, DevOps engineers, and customer stakeholders to drive solution adoption, operational scalability, and long-term platform maintainability

### **Technical Experience & Tooling**

Candidates should demonstrate hands-on architecture and design experience across the following domains:

* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in both Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure enterprise data ecosystems.
* Processing Engines: Apache Spark, PySpark, Databricks, Azure Synapse / Fabric Spark, GCP Dataproc.
* Modern Migration & AI Automation: Building automated, agentic, or metadata-driven data migration pipelines, automated schema conversion, and data validation agents for on-prem to cloud lift-and-shift/re-platforming.
* Messaging & Streaming: Apache Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, Azure Event Hubs.
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow, Google Cloud Composer, Azure Data Factory (ADF).
* Analytical Storage & Warehouses: GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake/Parquet.
* NoSQL / Cache Storage: MongoDB, Redis, Bigtable, Azure Cosmos DB.
* Containerization & Deployment: Kubernetes (GKE and AKS), Cloud Run, Azure Container Apps.
* API Frameworks: Python (FastAPI, Flask) for data service endpoints.
* Databases & Querying: Advanced SQL validation and extraction from legacy/RDBMS systems (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL).
* CI/CD & Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

### **Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data Platform architecture.
* 5+ years architecting, migrating, and deploying production data platforms across GCP and/or Azure, with proven multi-cloud integration patterns.
* Demonstrated track record leading on-premises/cloud to cloud modernization/migration initiatives, including data ingestion, transformation, automated data reconciliation, and cutover strategies.
* Experience designing or integrating autonomous, agent-driven, or LLM-augmented data workflows (e.g., automated schema mapping, code conversion, data quality validation agents).
* Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying Lakehouse platforms incorporating Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and Data Mesh / Data Product principles.
* Deep knowledge of multi-cloud data governance, access management, and cataloging (Dataplex, Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
* Strong leadership capability in technical backlog management, agile scoping, sprint planning, and setting technical strategy for distributed teams.
* Exceptional stakeholder communication skills: capability to articulate architectural trade-offs to C-level executives as smoothly as reviewing code with engineers.

### **Preferred Qualifications (Optional / Good to Have)**

* Multi-cloud certifications: *Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer / Cloud Architect* and/or *Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate / Azure Solutions Architect Expert*.
* Hands-on knowledge of Snowflake and Databricks
* Familiarity with AWS data services (Amazon S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR).
* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or agentic framework integrations in data operations.

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Sr Principal Cloud Engineer
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

**Organization Background**

* Technology Engineering and Operations owns the engineering, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the Cloud and OnPrem hosting environments.
* The environment is Azure-first and includes multi-subscription governance, hub-spoke networking, cloud platform services, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, backup and recovery, security integration, FinOps, ServiceNow/CMDB, and managed operations delivered in partnership vendor partners.
* The Principal Cloud Engineer will serve as the senior technical lead and L4 escalation point, retaining platform engineering ownership while guiding vendor partners responsible for day-to-day operations.

**What will you be responsible for?**

* Own the technical engineering and operational integrity of the Azure platform.
* Define and maintain Azure Landing Zone standards covering Management Groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy, RBAC, tagging, resource locks, diagnostics, cost controls, and approved service patterns.
* Lead complex Azure operations and engineering across compute, storage, AKS, App Services, Key Vault, databases, backup, monitoring, and resource lifecycle management.
* Provide technical leadership for Azure networking, including hub-spoke connectivity, VNets, NSGs, UDRs, Private Endpoints, DNS, Azure Firewall, and integration with Palo Alto and Infoblox.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent platforms, including reusable modules, code reviews, testing, deployment pipelines, drift management, and secure state handling.
* Own platform reliability, observability, capacity, patching, backup, restore, BCP/DR readiness, and continual service improvement.
* Act as the L4 escalation point for major incidents, lead technical RCA and problem management, and ensure preventive actions are implemented.
* Guide and govern vendor resources performing L1/L2/L3 monitoring, fulfillment, troubleshooting, patching, backup, and standard changes.
* Partner with Cyber, IAM, Network, M365, EUC, Product Engineering, Compliance, Finance, and Service Management teams to deliver secure and supportable solutions.
* Lead technical reviews through TRB/architecture governance and ensure new workloads meet security, compliance, cost, operational readiness, and service ownership requirements.
* Drive cloud cost optimization, tagging compliance, consumption visibility, and FinOps recommendations.
* Mentor engineers, establish engineering practices, and communicate platform health, risks, decisions, and roadmap updates to senior stakeholders.

**What would your day look like?**

* Review platform health, availability, alerts, cost, policy compliance, capacity, backup, patching, and operational risks.
* Provide engineering guidance and approval for non-standard Azure requests, network changes, new services, and product onboarding designs.
* Develop or review Terraform modules, automation, pipelines, scripts, and reusable platform patterns.
* Lead complex troubleshooting across Azure infrastructure, AKS, private connectivity, DNS, identity dependencies, and application platform services.
* Participate in Major Incident bridges, approve RCAs, and drive permanent corrective and reliability improvements.
* Review vendor teams operational performance, changes, tickets, runbooks, evidence, SLA trends, and recurring issues.
* Work with Product teams to define monitoring, backup, recovery, RTO/RPO, service ownership, CMDB, and operational acceptance requirements.
* Present technical decisions, risks, investment needs, KPIs, and roadmap progress to leadership and governance forums.

**Who are we looking for?**

* 10-13 years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, or enterprise operations, including significant hands-on Microsoft Azure experience.
* Proven experience operating and engineering complex, production-grade Azure environments with strong ownership of reliability and service outcomes.
* Deep understanding of Azure Landing Zones, Management Groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy, RBAC/PIM integration, tagging, diagnostics, governance, and cost controls.
* Strong hands-on Azure networking knowledge covering VNets, peering, NSGs, UDRs, Private Endpoints, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPN, and hybrid connectivity.
* Hands-on expertise in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform; experience with Bicep, ARM, or other IaC platforms is beneficial.
* Experience with AKS/Kubernetes, Windows and Linux workloads, storage, databases, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, backup, recovery, and patching.
* Strong understanding of ITSM processes including Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, Request, Knowledge, CMDB, and operational acceptance.
* Experience leading technical resolution of P1/P2 incidents, conducting RCA, and implementing preventive engineering actions.
* Working knowledge of cloud security, Zero Trust, encryption, vulnerability remediation, compliance controls, and frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS, or MCSB.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, ambiguous, and rapidly scaling environment with multiple Product, Enterprise Service, Innovation, vendor, and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, technical documentation, mentoring, and influencing skills.
* Ability to balance hands-on engineering with platform leadership, governance, vendor oversight, and strategic planning.

**Good to Have**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, or Azure Network/Security certification.
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate or equivalent IaC/DevOps certification.
* Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, policy-as-code, automation using PowerShell/Python/Azure CLI, and self-service provisioning.
* Exposure to Palo Alto, GlobalProtect, Infoblox, Cloudflare, ManageEngine/Site24x7, ServiceNow, CrowdStrike, Rapid7, and Proofpoint integration patterns.
* Experience with healthcare, regulated workloads, customer-hosting platforms, or compliance/audit readiness.

**Leadership and Behavioral Expectations**

* Demonstrates strong ownership and serves as a trusted technical authority for the platform.
* Leads through influence and can align Product, Platform, Cyber, Operations, and vendor stakeholders.
* Communicates clearly with engineers, service owners, and executive leadership.
* Uses structured decision-making, measurable outcomes, and risk-based prioritization.
* Promotes automation, standardization, operational discipline, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. title: Development Operations Engineer
description:
### **Description**

Infor are recruiting a **Development Operations Engineer** who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, automation, and operational excellence. This role is central to ensuring the continuous delivery and stability of Infor's cutting-edge cloud-based enterprise software, including our large-scale ERP SaaS solutions. The ideal candidate has a track record of automating zero-downtime deployments for enterprise-scale software and is equally comfortable operating in AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform alongside our in-house automation tooling.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support seamless, zero-downtime delivery of enterprise-scale applications such as ERP SaaS solutions.
* Build and extend in-house automation tooling to streamline deployments, operational tasks, and developer workflows.
* Collaborate with cross-functional product teams to support build, test, and deployment automation.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and proactively optimize infrastructure across AWS and Kubernetes environments.
* Develop infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform (and AWS CloudFormation where applicable) to provision and manage cloud resources.
* Administer and tune Linux and Windows Server systems supporting production and non-production environments.
* Contribute to the standardization and automation of development workflows and operational tasks using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Support application scalability, security, and resilience in alignment with Infor's cloud-first strategy.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response to ensure high availability of services.
* Document processes, procedures, and solutions to ensure knowledge sharing and maintainability.

### **Basic Qualifications:**

* **5-7 Years experience in DevOps**, SRE, or related engineering role supporting large enterprise-scale software, ideally ERP or other SaaS solutions.
* Proven experience automating zero-downtime deployments for high-availability systems.
* **Expert-level scripting ability in Python, Bash, and PowerShell.**
* **Extensive experience with Linux and Windows Server system administration.**
* Experience with **CI/CD tools** such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, plus building or maintaining in-house automation tooling.
* **Hands-on experience with AWS and container orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker.**
* Experience developing infrastructure as code with **Terraform**.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).
* Experience working in regulated industries or following compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, etc.).
* Experience with Agile development practices and tools (JIRA, Confluence).
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).
* Experience with security best practices in cloud-native environments.

### **About Infor**

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. • Lead functional workshops for Invoice-to-Cash (ITC) processes across Order Management (OM), Accounts Receivable (AR), Advanced Pricing, Credit Management, Revenue Management, and Collections in Oracle Fusion Financials & SCM Cloud.

• 10–15+ years of ERP experience with 7+ years in Oracle Fusion Financials Cloud, focused on Invoice-to-Cash (AR, OM, Pricing, RMCS).

• Analyze current-state receivables and billing processes and design future-state ITC flows aligned with Oracle Fusion Cloud best practices.

• Configure Oracle Fusion modules including Accounts Receivable (AR), OM, Advanced Pricing, Credit Management, Auto Invoice, Revenue Accounting (RMCS), and related setups.

• Develop and maintain Business Process Design (BPD) documents,

Configuration Workbooks, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), and end-to-end ITC process documentation.

• Configure and support customer master data, transaction types, invoicing rules, accounting rules, receipt methods, lockboxes, tax integration, and revenue recognition.

• Validate ITC integration touchpoints with Order-to-Cash (OTC),

Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), SCM, Tax, and EPM modules.

• Collaborate with integration teams to define and test interfaces for orders, invoices, receipts, credit memos, revenue data, and customer balances using OIC, FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs.

• Support Auto Invoice, receipt processing, bank lockbox, customer payments, adjustments, write-offs, disputes, and collections workflows.

• Ensure accurate Subledger Accounting (SLA) for Accounts Receivable,

including revenue, tax, freight, and adjustments posting to GL.

• Support ITC-related data migration including customer conversion, open AR balances, invoices, receipts, and historical revenue data.

• Create and execute test scenarios for SIT, UAT, regression testing, and

end-to-end Order-to-Cash cycles.

• Validate ITC accounting accuracy across AR subledger, SLA rules, RMCS postings, and GL reconciliation. Oracle Invoice-to-Cash (ITC) Functional Consultant.

• Provide functional support during cutover, go-live, deployments, and hyper care activities.

• Collaborate with reporting teams to validate OTBI, BI Publisher, AR Aging, Revenue reports, and customer statements.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or related discipline.

• Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash and Invoice-to-Cash processes,

revenue recognition, customer billing, credit management, and collections.

• Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Auto Invoice, receipt processing, lockbox, and SLA configuration.

• Experience with Revenue Management (RMCS) and compliance with ASC 606/ IFRS 15.

• Familiarity with upstream integrations from SCM / OM and downstream financial reporting requirements.

• Experience working with integrations using OIC, FBDI, REST/SOAP APIs, and ITC reporting tools (OTBI, BI Publisher).

• Hands-on experience with data migration for customers, AR balances, invoices and receipts.

• Experience supporting multi-currency, multi-ledger, and multi-region

environments.

• Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Prior experience supporting multi-region Oracle Cloud implementations (NA,EMEA, APAC).

• Experience managing quarterly Oracle Cloud updates and assessing impact on ITC processes.

• Preferred Certifications: Oracle Cloud Financials Certification (AR / OM /RMCS).

  
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

title: Application & Cloud Security Lead
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

11

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.

The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.

This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
* Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
* Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
* Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
* Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
* Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
* Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
* Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
* Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
* Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
* Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.

title: OMEGAMON Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As an OMEGAMON Specialist at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Implement and maintain OMEGAMON monitoring infrastructure.
* Monitor health of z/OS, CICS, DB2, IMS, MQ, and storage subsystems.
* Develop automated alerting and event correlation.
* Create dashboards and operational reporting.
* Support proactive detection of performance degradation.
Integrate monitoring data with AIOps and Bridge analytics initiatives.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

### **Required Technical Skills**

  

* 5+ years of experience in OMEGAMON Suite Administration and Mainframe Monitoring.
* Strong experience with IBM OMEGAMON Suite and Tivoli Monitoring.
* Knowledge of Enterprise Monitoring Architecture and monitoring best practices.
* Expertise in RMF and SMF analysis for performance monitoring and capacity planning.
* Experience in performance baseline development and trend analysis.
* Strong understanding of event correlation and threshold management.
* Expertise in root cause analysis and systems diagnostics.
* Knowledge of automation concepts and AIOps integration.
* Experience with Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019 implementation, administration, and management.
* Hands-on experience with VMware ESXi and virtualization technologies.
* Experience managing public and private cloud environments, including migration from on-premises infrastructure to cloud solutions.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management, security compliance, and infrastructure hardening.
* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS).
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation technologies.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.  

  

### **Preferred Skills**

  

* IBM OMEGAMON or IBM Z Monitoring certifications.
* Experience with IBM Z Monitoring Suite, IBM Tivoli Monitoring (ITM), and IBM NetView.
* Knowledge of IBM Z AIOps, Watson AIOps, or similar AIOps platforms.
* Experience integrating monitoring data with Splunk, Elastic, Grafana, or other enterprise analytics tools.
* Familiarity with System Automation for z/OS (SA z/OS) and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of z/OSMF, Parallel Sysplex, and IBM Z infrastructure.
* Experience with REXX, JCL, and automation scripting.
* Understanding of CICS, Db2, IMS, MQ, and enterprise storage performance monitoring.
* Experience with ITIL Incident, Problem, and Event Management processes.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience supporting 24x7 mission-critical enterprise production environments.
* Ability to mentor team members and contribute to monitoring strategy and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Experience with cloud automation, IaC frameworks, and enterprise monitoring modernization initiatives.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Architect
description:

The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
* 5+ years of professional software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI development experience
* 3+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning solutions in production environments
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs), embeddings, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases

title: Senior Director, AI and Data Platform Delivery
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery is a senior leadership role accountable for **end‑to‑end execution of Teradata’s foundational AI and data platform offerings**, which underpin the company’s hybrid, multi‑cloud, and on‑premises solutions. This role is critical to ensuring that Teradata’s **platform continues to scale, modernize, and reliably support customer workloads**, while enabling company growth through platform differentiation, adoption, and expansion.

This leader owns the **execution strategy, operating model, and talent development** for a combined organization of **Technical Program Managers (TPMs)** and **Global Program Managers (GPMs)**. Together, these teams drive coordinated execution across the end-to-end **New Product Introduction (NPI) process**, ensuring that new platform elements are fully productized, operationally ready, and commercially viable.

Success in this role is measured by **platform delivery predictability, quality, scalability, and business impact**, rather than ownership of individual programs.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Platform Execution & Growth Enablement**

* Own execution outcomes for significant areas of Teradata’s **core data platform and AI roadmap**, including platform modernization, scalability enhancements, cloud parity, and operational hardening.
* Be accountable for execution work that **enables Teradata’s growth and retention targets**, including platform readiness for new use cases, expansions, and customer adoption.
* Translate product and platform strategy into **integrated execution plans** that balance stability, innovation, customer commitments, and long‑term technical health.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Commercial leadership to align platform execution with **market needs, competitive positioning, and revenue objectives**.
* Provide execution transparency and decision support to senior leadership for **tradeoffs impacting delivery, quality, and customer trust**.

**End‑to‑End New Product Introduction (NPI) Leadership**

* Lead the global NPI execution model for core and AI platform capabilities from concept through general availability and sustained customer adoption.
* Ensure cross‑functional coordination across:
* + Definition, development, and testing
  + Product setup, configuration, and entitlement
  + Legal, compliance, and contractual readiness
  + Pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management
  + Go‑to‑market readiness (Sales, Marketing, Solution Architects)
  + Cloud Operations, infrastructure, and SRE readiness
  + Customer support, field enablement, and documentation
* Establish scalable, repeatable NPI mechanisms that support **frequent platform releases and long‑lived customer environments**.

**Technical & Platform Leadership**

* Provide technical and execution leadership across **large‑scale, distributed, data‑intensive platforms**, spanning cloud, hybrid, and on‑prem deployments.
* Guide teams through complex platform delivery challenges involving **performance, reliability, scalability, security, upgrade paths, and operational continuity**.
* Ensure cross‑team technical and operational risks are proactively identified, clearly owned, and mitigated.
* Partner with senior engineering and architecture leaders to ensure execution plans align with **long‑term platform sustainability and customer trust**.
* Co-own with engineering **platform economics and cost‑to‑serve** by influencing execution tradeoffs that impact margin, scaling limits, and long‑term pricing power.
* Co-own with engineering and product the **platform lifecycle governance and technical debt liquidation** at the portfolio level.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and scale a high‑impact organization of **Technical Program Managers and Global Program Managers**.
* Clearly define and reinforce roles and interfaces between TPMs (engineering‑centric delivery) and GPMs (cross‑functional, post‑code, market and operational readiness).
* Own hiring, performance management, development, and succession planning for the platform execution organization.
* Develop senior TPM and GPM leaders capable of operating effectively at **enterprise scale and high ambiguity**.
* Establish clear leveling, expectations, and promotion readiness standards for both TPM and GPM career paths.

**Influence, Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Act as a **trusted execution advisor** to senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer organizations.
* Communicate platform execution health, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs clearly at the **VP and executive level**.
* Drive alignment across a highly matrixed organization supporting long‑lived, mission‑critical customer environments.
* Provide executive clarity during high‑impact incidents, major releases, or customer‑sensitive platform transitions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product operations, or related technical roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading senior technical and program management professionals.
* Proven success delivering **large‑scale, enterprise data platform initiatives**.
* Strong understanding of **distributed systems, database platforms, cloud infrastructure, and hybrid architectures**.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution that supports **business growth, customer retention, and platform adoption**.
* Exceptional executive‑level communication and influence skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering or operating **enterprise data platforms** in cloud and hybrid environments.
* Background supporting **platform modernization, cloud transitions, or large customer migrations**.
* Experience building or scaling global NPI and release governance models.
* Familiarity with operational excellence, SRE practices, and enterprise reliability expectations.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Senior Director of AI and Data Platform Delivery:

* Enables Teradata to **deliver and evolve its core platform with predictability and confidence**.
* Holds the organization to **best-in-breed standards** across delivery quality, platform performance, and operational reliability — ensuring Teradata's core data platform earns a reputation for excellence.

title: Principal Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.
  + Use data and telemetry to identify AI quality gaps, generate insights, and deliver **proofs of concept** that apply research innovations to real‑world operational challenges.
  + Design robust **multi‑step reasoning and tool‑use strategies**, including function calling, code execution, APIs, and secure connectors, with strong safety and reliability guardrails.
  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**
  + Define task‑level evaluation metrics for agentic behavior, including **success rate, tool‑call accuracy, step efficiency, hallucination rate, safety violations, time‑to‑completion, and user satisfaction**.
  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design
    - A/B experimentation and telemetry‑driven iteration loops
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines and Lead Technical Execution**
  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.
  + Lead design reviews and influence engineering decisions across **agent frameworks, model integration, and system architecture**.
  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.
* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model serving/inference.
* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cloud technology Stack
* Experience with **parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning** techniques (e.g., LoRA) for LLMs or multimodal models.
* Hands‑on experience building **agentic or tool‑augmented LLM systems**, including function calling, planners, and API/tool integration.
* Experience with **advanced RAG architectures**, such as hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citation strategies.
* Strong **AIOps depth**, including quality drift detection, alerting, rollback, and telemetry‑driven optimization.
* Experience optimizing systems for **latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency** at enterprise scale.
* Prior experience working on **mission‑critical or large‑scale enterprise AI systems**.
* Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership within applied science or engineering teams.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Principal ServiceNow Architect – ITSM & Enterprise Workflow
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Principal ServiceNow Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, technical governance, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions. The individual will be responsible for translating business and IT requirements into secure, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform capabilities aligned with ITIL best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

The role requires a strong combination of ServiceNow platform expertise, hands-on technical proficiency, ITSM process knowledge, integration architecture, and stakeholder management. The candidate must be capable of independently handling complex technical challenges, evaluating existing implementations, identifying architectural gaps, and driving solutions from design through deployment and operational support.

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, ITSM process owners, platform administrators, developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and delivery leadership.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Define the ServiceNow platform architecture, technical standards, design principles, and implementation guidelines.

Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

Lead architecture assessments, solution design reviews, technical feasibility assessments, and architectural decision-making.

Evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities against customization requirements and prioritize configuration over custom development wherever feasible.

Define reusable architectural patterns, application boundaries, data models, and integration approaches.

Maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, technical specifications, and architecture decision records.

Assess existing implementations to identify technical debt, architectural inconsistencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. ITSM and ITIL Process Architecture**

Design and govern ServiceNow ITSM capabilities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog.

Align platform workflows with ITIL 4 principles and enterprise service management policies.

Review and optimize incident categorization, impact, urgency, priority, assignment rules, escalation, and SLA management.

Define appropriate priority calculation and escalation models, ensuring that business impact and urgency drive consistent prioritization.

Establish standards for incident lifecycle management, major incident handling, problem investigation, change risk assessment, approvals, and service restoration.

Ensure that process implementations are consistent, measurable, auditable, and aligned with operational objectives.

Challenge unnecessary customizations or process variations that increase complexity without delivering measurable business value.

**3. Technical Architecture and Advanced Development**

Provide technical leadership for complex ServiceNow implementations, custom applications, workflows, and platform enhancements.

Demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideSystem, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer.

Design and troubleshoot advanced automation, event-driven processing, asynchronous operations, and complex workflow logic.

Define appropriate use of IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, scripting, scheduled jobs, events, and platform-native capabilities.

Review code for quality, security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow development standards.

Diagnose complex defects, production incidents, transaction failures, slow-running scripts, and unexpected platform behavior.

Establish development standards, code review practices, reusable components, and technical documentation.

**4. Integration and Data Architecture**

Design and govern integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other supported integration mechanisms.

Define authentication, authorization, API security, error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and integration resiliency.

Lead integration design across identity management, monitoring tools, ERP, CRM, HR, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications.

Establish data ownership, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation standards.

Govern CMDB data integrations, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality where applicable.

Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, data inconsistencies, API errors, and performance constraints.

**5. Platform Governance, Security, and Performance**

Establish platform governance, development lifecycle standards, application access controls, and technical quality gates.

Ensure appropriate use of roles, ACLs, authentication, authorization, encryption, and sensitive-data controls.

Define instance strategy, application scope, update-set or application deployment practices, and environment promotion controls.

Establish release, upgrade, regression-testing, and rollback strategies in collaboration with platform operations.

Assess customization impact on upgrades and minimize upgrade conflicts.

Monitor platform health, transaction performance, script efficiency, integration reliability, and technical debt.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, audit requirements, and applicable governance standards.

**6. CMDB, Service Mapping, and ITOM**

Define CMDB architecture, configuration item classes, relationships, ownership, and data quality controls.

Establish configuration management standards and alignment between business services, technical services, and supporting infrastructure.

Provide architectural guidance for Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and operational visibility where these capabilities are in scope.

Define integration patterns for infrastructure monitoring and service health data.

Ensure that CMDB and operational data support incident impact analysis, change risk assessment, and service availability objectives.

**7. ServiceNow Product and Platform Strategy**

Evaluate and recommend appropriate ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, IT Asset Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Security Operations, and Integrated Risk Management, according to business needs.

Assess product fit, licensing implications, implementation complexity, dependencies, and business value.

Identify opportunities to consolidate fragmented workflows and reduce overlapping tools or custom-built solutions.

Define platform evolution roadmaps, capability maturity improvements, and modernization priorities.

Stay current with relevant ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, architecture guidance, and recommended practices.

**8. Delivery Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product managers, project managers, and delivery teams to establish solution scope and technical priorities.

Lead architecture workshops, technical design discussions, proof-of-concept exercises, and solution demonstrations.

Provide technical direction and mentoring to developers, administrators, technical leads, and implementation partners.

Review estimates, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and implementation plans.

Support testing strategy, defect triage, deployment readiness, go-live, and post-production stabilization.

Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

12–15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on ServiceNow experience.

Typically 8+ years of ServiceNow implementation and development experience, including significant ownership of complex technical solutions.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures.

Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL principles; ITIL 4 certification is preferred.

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification; relevant implementation and architect-level certifications are strongly preferred.

Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise, including complex debugging and code reviews.

Proven experience with REST/SOAP integrations, authentication, data transformation, and integration troubleshooting.

Experience with platform security, access controls, performance optimization, release management, and upgrades.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Ability to work independently, make architecture decisions, explain technical trade-offs, and take ownership of complex issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.

Relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications, particularly ITSM and ITOM where applicable.

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect credentials, where held and relevant to the role.

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, service management governance, and technical debt reduction.

Experience leading multi-team implementations, platform modernization, and enterprise integration programs.

**Expected Outcomes**

A clearly defined, documented, and governed ServiceNow architecture.

Consistent implementation of ITSM processes aligned with business policies and ITIL principles.

Improved platform stability, integration reliability, maintainability, and upgrade readiness.

Reduced unnecessary customization, technical debt, recurring defects, and avoidable production incidents.

Stronger code quality, security controls, documentation, and deployment governance.

A prioritized platform improvement roadmap tied to measurable business and operational outcomes.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Incorta Development and Data Modeling**

* Design and maintain Incorta physical schemas, business schemas, joins, materialized views, formula columns, measures, dimensions, and derived attributes.
* Configure ingestion jobs, data sources, pipelines, load plans, incremental refreshes, and data validation controls.
* Develop reusable semantic and dimensional models that support governed self\-service analytics.
* Translate complex business and reporting requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

**Reporting, Analytics, and Performance**

* Build complex operational, management, and executive dashboards and reports across multiple subject areas.
* Implement calculations, aggregations, filters, drilldowns, KPIs, exception reporting, and role\-based access.
* Troubleshoot and optimize queries, joins, formulas, schemas, ingestion patterns, and dashboard performance.
* Reconcile report outputs to source systems and resolve data quality or reporting discrepancies.

**Integration and Delivery**

* Integrate Incorta with ERP, CRM, WMS, TMS, finance, HR, and other enterprise source systems using database, API, file, or cloud\-based patterns.
* Work with data engineers on source mappings, transformations, data quality, refresh schedules, and lineage.
* Support design reviews, testing, UAT, defect resolution, releases, production support, and technical documentation.
* Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior developers and report developers.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* 6–10 years in business intelligence, enterprise reporting, data analytics, or data warehousing, including substantial Incorta development experience.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Incorta schemas, ingestion, Analyzer, dashboards, security, materialized views, and performance tuning.
* Advanced SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance\-aware query design.
* Strong understanding of semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings, incremental loads, data profiling, and data governance.
* Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar databases; familiarity with APIs, JSON/XML, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder\-management, and documentation skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Incorta certification or formal training; experience with Incorta Cloud.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Cognos, or comparable BI tools.
* Experience delivering analytics for supply chain, finance, procurement, sales, operations, or HR.
* Experience with end\-to\-end reporting\-platform implementation, migration, or modernization.

**EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage. The successful candidate demonstrates ownership, attention to data accuracy, structured problem solving, collaboration, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
